build_sphinx_docs: run sphinx-build to generate HTML documentation from the docs directory using apitree configuration
configure_apitree_project: configure apitree make_project with gemma modules gm and peft for API documentation generation
include_colab_notebooks: include colab notebooks like finetuning and lora_sampling as part of the documentation build
redirect_colab_pages: redirect empty HTML pages to their corresponding colab HTML documentation pages
review_conf_py: review the Sphinx conf.py configuration file to understand documentation build setup and colab includes
